rows.proof: The student graph states an even quadratic y=f'(x) with f'(1)=2 and a constant y=2 branch for x>=1, but gives no exact vertex value. For every a>2, f'(x)=a*x^2+2-a on x<=1 has the stated symmetry and junction. Its implied f(-1)f(3)=20a/3-15; a=3 gives 5 and a=4 gives 35/3. Therefore the current student image does not determine one listed answer.
The student conditions admit f1=x^4-2x^2-2 and f2=x^4-4x^2-2. For each, |f|=2 has five distinct real roots, yet f1(3)=61 and f2(3)=43. The stated conditions do not determine f(3).
